question.text: When the strike price increases (all else constant), the impact on option values is:

answer.text: Call value decreases, Put value increases
Both call and put values increase
Call value increases, Put value decreases

explanation.text: The Logic: Higher strike makes it harder for a call buyer to profit (must rise higher) → call value decreases. Higher strike makes it easier for a put buyer to profit (sell at higher price) → put value increases. The Trap: The effect is opposite — what benefits puts hurts calls when strike changes. Cross-Exam Context: Series VIII covers strike price impact identically.
